usage: policy for libraries indirectly referenced in code utilizing company approved licenses
name: Dependencies not being referenced in the code should be removed.
description: Utilizing libraries with unauthorized licenses may open a company up to copyright infringement.
detailedDescription: Using unauthorized libraries based on their licenses may require your project to be open sourced or lead to copyright infringement. A U.S. Federal court has ruled that an open-source license is an enforceable contract.
